name: Login from unfamiliar device, location or infrastructure
description: Session originates from a device, country, emulator or network not previously associated with the customer, including shortly after a phishing event.
fp: Travel, new phones and VPN use are common legitimate causes.

links.name: Login from new device, country or emulator
links.ctx: Session originates from unfamiliar infrastructure, possibly using an emulator or anonymising proxy.

links.name: Login from new device shortly after phishing click
links.ctx: Attacker-side: credentials harvested via a fake site are used on an unfamiliar device or location.
